name: DPP publisher key policy v1: a chain of versions, and the keys active at a time

vectors.description: A genesis signed by the operator identity, a rotation signed by the retiring key, and a handover into a federation countersigned by the incoming operator. The preimage is the canonical JSON of each version without its signature values; the digest is the canonical JSON complete.
Under a federation no operator authorises a key alone: the fourth version is signed by an active key and countersigned by the other operator.
A genesis signed by a key that is no operator identity in its scope.
The genesis with a publisher key swapped after signing.
A later version that names no superseded version.
A later version naming the right version number and the wrong digest.
A later version issued before the one it supersedes.
A genesis authorisation after the first version.
A rotation signed by the incoming key, which was not active under the superseded version.
A handover without the incoming operator's countersignature.
A handover countersigned by the outgoing operator instead of the incoming one.
A rotation under a federation signed by one operator's key with no countersignature.
A publisher entry whose retirement precedes its activation.
